method: Independent verified backups opened read-only; metadata and every region hashed. Derived physical-distance, four-neighbour land connectivity and resource/memory summaries; no simulation advanced or host contacted.
limits: A geometrically connected cell is not proof of known resources, access permission, bounded path-search success, delivery time or renewable yield.
Catchments overlap; their resources must not be added as independent inventories.
Edible tissue is a standing upper stock, not sustainable production or the yield of one gathering visit.
